mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate signals tightening monetary policy, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05 in a t-test) despite rising FEDFUNDS rates, or if other macro factors like inflation dominate the signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals labor market strength, boosting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05 in a t-test) despite falling UNRATE, or if wage growth outpaces employment gains.

mechanism_narrative: HOUST (demand) crossing above 900 indicates rising demand for goods and services, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05 in a t-test) despite HOUST crossing above 900, or if other demand indicators like GDPC1 are weaker.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both GDPC1 (demand) and HOUST (demand) signals robust demand growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05 in a t-test) despite both proxies rising, or if one proxy rises while the other falls.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a decline in FEDFUNDS rates signals easing monetary policy, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05 in a t-test) despite FEDFUNDS declining in a late-cycle context, or if inflationary pressures override the signal.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both GDPC1 (demand) and INDPRO (supply) indicates a balanced supply-demand cycle, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05 in a t-test) despite both proxies rising, or if supply outpaces demand excessively.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in UNRATE below 6.5% signals a tight labor market, boosting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05 in a t-test) despite UNRATE falling below 6.5%, or if wage growth outpaces employment gains.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a rise in FEDFUNDS rates signals higher inflation expectations, compressing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05 in a t-test) despite FEDFUNDS rising in a tightening cycle, or if GDP growth offsets the rate hike impact.
